summary: Mission presentations reserve working for active steps assigned to agents. Agentless steps awaiting human gates use the existing needs-you wording and name the person who must answer; before a gate is published they read held/waiting, not working.

replay.detail: Presentation-only change; no stored state changes.

schema.detail: Existing presentation words and actor types are reused.

compatibility.detail: Shared mission presentations change consistently for TUI, web and iOS without new wire vocabulary.

downtime.detail: Takes effect with the next normal daemon deployment.
